_help: Camp books, §ED.3 (4 Oct 2026). One per camp, on an altar or shelf by the hearth; the camp sim's only readout. Lines are in the folk's hand, stamped in game time; ink darkens by age (fresh -> brown over age_brown_days). rumour: when an overrun ruin (§CN) is within range_m, the newest line points at it, worded from its smoke state (§CV). Reading copies the rumour into the player's log.

object.placement: altar or shelf by the hearth

rumour.no_smoke: No smoke from the {ruin} for a season.
rumour.thin_smoke: The fire at the {ruin} burns low; nobody goes.
